compose_two_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose(g1, g2)
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a graph using gtn.forward_score(g)
find_viterbi_path: find the highest scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path(g)
union_multiple_graphs: compute the union of multiple graphs using gtn.union([g1, g2, g3])
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a graph using gtn.remove(g)
